channel.title: Component history · orvui
channel.description: orvui release notes and compatibility changes. The component package is available on npm; see the installation guide to get started.

item.title: orvui 0.1.1
item.description:
Updated npm installation guides, with a public MCP endpoint and component skills loaded on demand.

  • fixed: Corrected installation instructions for the existing npm package, including upgrades from 0.1.0 to 0.1.1 and Nuxt stylesheet setup. Installation
  • new: The public read-only MCP provides component documentation, source, styles and theme queries through a URL connection. MCP
  • new: The complete Agent Skills archive includes Chinese and English references for 110 components and 72 registered variants. Agent Skills
  • improved: The package, registry and AI resources share version 0.1.1, retaining public APIs, motion, eleven palettes and semantic theme overrides.

item.title: Component implementation update
item.description:
Component runtime and demonstrations have been rebuilt while keeping the public interfaces.

  • improved: Catalog and generated resources now use the orvui product version, with stable entry points for 109 components and 72 registered examples. Installation
  • improved: Shared layers and theme generation have been rebuilt with the eleven palette values held fixed. Themes
  • improved: Site fonts are sourced directly from the installed Fontsource packages, with their own licenses and file checksums retained.
